notes: Single-stage: build a reusable AST-based static analyzer that recognizes eight vulnerability patterns in Python web-service source and maps each to the exact CWE id, with safe look-alike distractors (parameterized SQL, shell=False lists, literal eval/redirect/system, sha256, json.load). Must generalize to hidden modules (module-level code, classes/methods, nested functions, mixed patterns). Rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (eight syntactic rules + scope attribution), debugging_ambiguity (literal vs non-literal edge rules), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (multiple hidden sources), quantitative_correctness (exact CWE ids). No tool breadth, no dependency chain, no environment pressure; totals bucket to hard.
